2026-11-03: the six layouts (Stack, Card wall, Story, Calendar first, Shop front, Profile) are built for all sixteen Services trade kits: components/spotlight/services-kit-layouts.tsx and services-kit-layouts-css.ts (--sv-* tokens, six owner accents on Night and Day) and lib/spotlight/services-kit-content.ts (doors built as the design's record.js builds DOORS, from each kit's tools; prices, open times, reviews and the quote are sample-only, so a live page gets none). Registered in lib/spotlight/layouts.ts as `services-kit:*`, drawn by the Spotlight shell and given Services' faces on the public Spotlight page. Not yet: the Services Spotlight preset starting on Stack, which needs the owner's phrase for the 'none for others' pin in components/spotlight/network-kit-layouts.test.tsx; until then an owner picks a layout in the Spotlight editor.

2026-11-04: the Services Spotlight preset starts on services-kit:stack (lib/spotlight/theme.ts), the way Network, Temple, Free Human and New World start on their own Stack. The two 'no layout for other presets' pins (network-kit-layouts.test.tsx, scripts/probes/network-kit-spotlight.mjs for LIVE-1712) admit services, on the owner's phrase.
